newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean 3-yr yields end up on heavy new issues.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean 3-yr yields end up on heavy new issues.

text.p: Yields on three-year benchmark corporate bonds closed higher for the third consecutive day on Thursday as huge new issues pressured market sentiment, traders said.
Instability in the short-term money market kept most buyers sidelined, they said.
* Overnight average call rates unchanged at 12.90
"The central bank is keeping short-term liquidity tight and many investors are choosing to sit on the sidelines," one broker said.
Three-month CD yields also gained on tighter liquidity conditions, they said.
